ceu: ✦ The sextile between Mercury and Saturn

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.
Until {H:1800261170000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up your money and what you value.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and your image: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to someone you come across.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.
Until {H:1800261170000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and your inner life: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Ask for what you are owed, politely and without fear.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
Until {H:1800261170000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up rest and your inner life.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and friendships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
Until {H:1800261170000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your career: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.
Until {H:1800261170000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up your career and your goals.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and your horizons: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.
Until {H:1800261170000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and intimacy: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
Until {H:1800261170000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and relationships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.
Until {H:1800261170000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and routine: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.
Until {H:1800261170000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and romance: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Do not try to change the other person: try to understand them.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.
Until {H:1800261170000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and family: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Start the day with the hardest task and the rest will feel light.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.
Until {H:1800261170000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up home and family.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and conversations: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Laugh at yourself when something goes less well.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
Until {H:1800261170000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and money: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Make peace with a childhood memory.
